authorities.name: Accessible UI Primitives & Overlays
authorities.role: Supplies accessible Buttons, Tabs, Inputs, and VisuallyHidden components.

authorities.name: Lead Sheet Chart Editing & Selection
authorities.role: Provides active selection state, event IDs, measure contexts, and edit intents.

authorities.name: Chord Syntax & Formatting
authorities.role: Parses chord symbol strings and generates canonical textual representations.

authorities.name: Chord Resolution & Spelling
authorities.role: Resolves chord qualities, spelled degrees, pitch classes, and tension categories. Chart-annotation@2 separately checks every exact resolved degree and spelled slash bass against its one suggested scale. It does not implement H0 plural readings, tension availability or clash evidence.

authorities.name: Voicing Generation
authorities.role: Generates jazz voicing family candidates (drop-2, rootless, quartal, etc.). The fixed rootless-a major template orders3,7,9,5 low to high; range64..79 uniquely gives E4,B4,D5,G5 for Cmaj9. Cmaj7 lacks9 and cannot certify that candidate.

authorities.name: Serialized Transport & Audio Stop Guarantee
authorities.role: Executes isolated chord audio previews without mutating progression state.

authorities.name: Foundation exact document data
authorities.role: U2 Refinement2; domain/chord.ts and domain/document.ts:16 exact notes, MIDI0..127,2000 Unicode code points. Arithmetic fixtures independently authored; no human listening or expert approval claimed. Policy3 makes all four inspector examples executable through F2/F3; Manual cannot claim generated Frozen provenance. Original policy2 bytes remain in Git3f52b83 (inspector SHA256ebc3d89fb135c9165ae70baee2e09b642688c0385ddd4129382d0892d8698a83).

laws.description: Inspector organizes chord analysis into exactly seven progressive tabs.
All128 MIDI coordinates remain accessible; a visual viewport never restricts valid notes.
Switching from Manual to Auto voicing requires user confirmation to prevent accidental loss.
One to16 notes preserve order, spelling, octave and duplicate unisons exactly in Manual/Frozen. Refuse17; never silently normalize.
Preserve up to2000 Unicode code points as inert text, including markup and controls. Refuse2001 without erasing the draft.
Chord preview sounds via real audio channels without side effects on playhead, selection, or document.
